title: ONNX-EdgeIDS: A Lightweight Two-Stage Edge Serving Toolkit for Network Intrusion Detection
description:
ONNX-EdgeIDS is research software for deploying machine-learning network intrusion detection on resource-constrained edge devices. It provides Kafka replay for CICIDS2017-derived flow records, a first-stage anomaly gate that filters high-volume traffic, and a second-stage ONNX Runtime classifier node for low-latency inference on Jetson-class hardware. The package also includes a transparent NumPy inference backend, artifact preparation scripts, feature-order checks, and validation utilities for comparing ONNX and NumPy predictions before deployment.

This release replaces the NumPy backend's per-tree Python loop with a block-lockstep traversal that advances cache-sized blocks of trees together. Its labels match ONNX Runtime on all 447,275 rows of the CICIDS2017 test split; on a Jetson Orin Nano Super the classifier node serves 2,752 instead of 127 rows/s at batch 20, and the first prediction after start-up takes 2.2 instead of 114 ms. classifier_node.py gains an optional --latency-csv that logs producer, gate and verdict timestamps per message. The lncs/ directory carries the experiment code and the Jetson result files behind the accompanying systems paper.
